title: Simulador Oficial Completo TOEIC® - Versión 6
description: Simulador completo real de Listening & Reading enfocado en Vortex Ltd y el líder the Operations Director.

parts.visual:
## 📝 Simulador Oficial TOEIC® (Versión 6)

Evaluación de **Listening & Reading** en tiempo real:

1. **Listening Section**: Evalúa tu comprensión en Vortex Ltd usando VortexCRM.
2. **Reading Section**: Mide tu análisis gramatical de memorandos emitidos por the Operations Director.

*Inicia tu prueba simulada oficial.*
parts.audio: Welcome to the Full TOEIC Simulation. Manage your time efficiently across both listening and reading stages. Let's begin.

questions.question: [PART 1 - PHOTO]: Select the best description of Vortex Ltd's office photo.
questions.audio_script: A) They are wearing safety helmets on the factory floor. B) They are purchasing safety equipment online. C) The assembly line is fully automated. D) They are repairing the conveyor belt.
questions.explanation: Los operarios llevan equipo de protección reglamentario (cascos y chalecos) en la planta industrial.

questions.question: [PART 3 - CONVERSATION]: Listen to the dialogue and answer: What does the man agree to do next?
questions.audio_script:
M: Hi Michael, did you receive the safety audit from Vortex Ltd?
W: Yes, the Operations Director sent it. The plant compliance is high, but we need to log the metrics in VortexCRM.
M: I will schedule a follow-up with the safety inspector.
options: Sign the contract as currently written.
Call the manager to negotiate an extension of the delivery window.
Write a new memorandum to sales staff.
questions.correct_answer: Call the manager to negotiate an extension of the delivery window.
questions.explanation: El hombre dice: 'I will call their manager to negotiate an extension'.

questions.question:
[PART 5]: Complete the business sentence correctly:

"All employees are strictly required to comply ___ the updated security rules in VortexCRM."
questions.explanation: El verbo 'comply' rige gramaticalmente la preposición 'with' (comply with / cumplir con).

questions.question:
[PART 7]: Read the memorandum and answer: **When will the migration to VortexCRM officially occur?**

**MEMORANDUM**

*To:* Plant Supervisors
*From:* Operations Department
*Subject: Quality Inspections & VortexCRM Registration*

Please note that starting next Sunday, all equipment inspection logs must be recorded in VortexCRM. A review session will be held this Saturday at 3:00 PM in the Conference Boardroom.
questions.explanation: El memorando dice: 'starting next Saturday, we are officially retiring our legacy sales tool and migrating to VortexCRM'.
